column3: Close to the Hebrew.

The Hebrew reads “from Baale-judah”; NASB has “to Baale-judah.” “Called by the name, the name” is rendered “called by the Name, the very name,” and “sits the cherubim” as “is enthroned above the cherubim.”
“Made to ride” is rendered “placed.”
Close to the Hebrew.
“On all woods of fir trees” is rendered “with all kinds of instruments made of fir wood”; “rattles” is rendered “castanets.”
“The oxen had stumbled” is rendered “the oxen nearly upset it.”
“On the presumption” (Hebrew עַל־ הַשַּׁל) is rendered “for his irreverence”; the meaning is uncertain.
“It burned to David” is rendered “David became angry,” and “broken out a breaking out” as “outburst.”
Close to the Hebrew.
“To turn aside to himself” is rendered “to move … with him.”
Close to the Hebrew.
“Household” is rendered “house,” and “for the sake of” as “on account of.”
“Steps” is rendered “paces.”
“Girded with a linen ephod” is rendered “wearing a linen ephod.”
Close to the Hebrew.
“Looked down” is rendered “looked out.”
Close to the Hebrew.
Close to the Hebrew.
“A date-cake” is rendered “one of dates”; the meaning of this word is uncertain.
“Honored himself” is rendered “distinguished himself,” and “worthless men” as “foolish ones.”
NASB supplies “It was” and “therefore,” and renders “play” as “celebrate.”
“Demean myself” is rendered “be more lightly esteemed,” and “honored” as “distinguished.”
Close to the Hebrew.
